summary: Minneapolis, Minnesota, 40-something male, 20+ years in software development, former C programmer, current focus on Java, Node.js, and NoSQL (Neo4j), startup founder, enjoys business side of tech, has two college-aged children, spouse with high-paying IT job, strong belief in the value of charter schools, advocates for diverse educational approaches, critical of mainstream corporate culture, supports open-source software, interested in Kanban methodologies, has a background in Unix systems programming, experienced in enterprise software, values hard work and intelligence, skeptical of traditional education paths, believes in the importance of mentorship and personal growth, engaged in discussions about immigration reform and economic issues, enjoys photography and music (guitar), critical of government overreach and media coverage, values personal freedom and entrepreneurship.
